sources.what: NSIDC Sea Ice Index, Version 4 (G02135), daily Northern Hemisphere sea-ice extent, CSV, 1978-10-26 to 2026-10-06
sources.used: columns Year, Month, Day, Extent only, reduced by prepare.py to data/extent.js
sources.why_not_committed: NSIDC asks for citation and states no redistribution licence for the file on its data-use page (https://nsidc.org/about/data-use-and-copyright, read 2026-10-07); per the house rule of 2026-08-18 the raw bytes are not committed. The derived numbers in data/extent.js are needed by every face and are published with the citation. The file is updated daily, so a later fetch will not match this hash.
sources.citation: Windnagel, A. K. & Stafford, T. (2025). Sea Ice Index. (G02135, Version 4). [Data Set]. Boulder, Colorado USA. National Snow and Ice Data Center. https://doi.org/10.7265/a98x-0f50. Daily NH extent CSV, accessed 2026-10-07.
